post.title: OMG Littermates passed 1000 Wishlists!
post.author: Alt10101
post.text: Huge milestone for our small little self funded indie team. We're super excited to have passed 1k wishlists just ahead of next fest. Fingers crossed next fest goes well! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4735880/Littermates/

game.name: Littermates
game.short_description: Grab your mates, steal some litter, and help the denizens of Raccoon-opolis as the newest member of The Duke's crew. Physics Mayhem with up to 8 mates! Drive your stolen Garbage Truck around neighbourhoods, racing to stay ahead of the sunrise as you try to collect everything that isn't nailed down.
